The '''Rift Valley''' was a [[rock]]y valley on the<ref name="WotF" /> [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TFA VD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[planet]] [[Dathomir]], and was the site of a past conflict.<ref name="WotF" /> Sometime between [[12 BBY]] and [[11 BBY]],<ref name="BattleScarsDate">{{BattleScarsDate}}</ref> [[Merrin]], a surviving member of the [[Battle of Dathomir|slaughter]] of the [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Dathomiri clan|clan]] of [[Dathomirian]] [[witch]]es<ref name="BattleScars">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Battle Scars]]''</ref> in [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Battle of Dathomir]] and slaughter of the [[Nightsisters]] to [[20 BBY]].</ref> attempted to [[Infiltration of a Haxion Brood base|infiltrate]] an [[asteroid]] [[Haxion Brood base|base]] of the [[Haxion Brood]] crime syndicate. While on the asteroid, she encountered the defecting [[Keshiri]] [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] analyst [[Chellwinark Frethylrin]]. Upon taking off the Frethylrin's [[Stormtrooper armor|helmet]], she noted that the Keshiri's [[eye]]s were as [[Color|red]] as the sky above the Rift Valley.<ref name="BattleScars" />
